title: Continuation-of-Care Discount on a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
**Financial counseling note.** A continuation discount applies to a Self-Pay Visit Package bought again in the same tier where the patient's Insured Plan of Care for the diagnosis code of the exhausted package, the condition the new package continues, was discharged no more than **120 calendar days** before the purchase: **12 percent** where it was discharged because the benefits were exhausted, **6 percent** where it was discharged for any other reason, and none where there is no such plan.

**What is read from the Insured Plan of Care**

- status discharged;
- diagnosis code equal to the diagnosis code on the exhausted Self-Pay Visit Package;
- discharge reason — benefits exhausted, or any other recorded reason (goals met, plateau, patient self-discharge, non-attendance, physician ordered, transferred care);
- discharge date, from which the calendar days to the purchase date are counted.

**Condition table**

| Discharged plan for the same diagnosis code | Discharged within 120 days before the purchase | Discharge reason | Continuation discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | benefits exhausted | 12 percent |
| Yes | Yes | any other reason | 6 percent |
| Yes | No — more than 120 days | any | none |
| No (different diagnosis, or plan not discharged) | — | — | none |

**Window cases (hypothetical, benefits exhausted)**

- Discharged 120 days before the purchase: 12 percent — the boundary day qualifies.
- Discharged 121 days before the purchase: none.
- Discharged for goals met 45 days before the purchase: 6 percent.
